gutter_wisp.codex_line: Marsh-light with an appetite for small valuables.
gutter_wisp.name: Gutter-wisp
gutter_wisp.flavor: Bottle-sized. Eats small lies. Wants what you're holding.
gutter_wisp.codex: A knot of marsh-light off the Mere that got into the drains and stayed. It feeds on small dishonesty — the sort everyone tells and nobody counts — which is why it is always found near people and never near the dead. Bottle-sized. Bites like a wasp with opinions.

wisp_pair.codex_line: Two wisps, one bad idea between them.
wisp_pair.name: A Conspiracy of Wisps
wisp_pair.flavor: Two wisps. One shared opinion about your belongings.
wisp_pair.codex: Two wisps that have started finishing each other's sentences. Nobody knows whether this is one creature or two, including, apparently, them. They share appetite and grudges and are twice as hard to lie past.

chained_dog.codex_line: Fourteen stone, on eleven measured feet of chain.
chained_dog.name: The Dog (On a Chain)
chained_dog.flavor: Wished to discuss territory. The meeting was declined.
chained_dog.codex: Fourteen stone of yard dog on eleven feet of chain, which he has measured to the inch and will not discuss. Within the circle he is absolute. Outside it he is a large, sad animal who would very much like to meet a cat properly.

garden_watch.codex_line: A goose, kept for the purpose.
garden_watch.name: The Garden Watch
garden_watch.flavor: A goose. Nobody warned you about the goose.
garden_watch.codex: A goose, kept for the purpose. The Watch commission them because a goose cannot be bribed, cannot be reasoned with, and does not sleep so much as briefly stop.

garden_watch_captain.codex_line: The senior goose. The chain of office is load-bearing.
garden_watch_captain.name: Captain of the Watch
garden_watch_captain.flavor: The goose has a chain of office. It is load-bearing.
garden_watch_captain.codex: The senior goose. It has a chain of office, and the chain of office is load-bearing: the others take their cue from it and will not commit until it does.

rag_wraith.codex_line: Clothes still holding the shape of somebody.
rag_wraith.name: Rag-wraith
rag_wraith.flavor: Clothes whose owner is missing. Not dead. Missing.
rag_wraith.codex: Clothing with the person taken out of it, still holding the shape. Where a rag-wraith walks, cut threads run towards it like water to a drain. Elspeth would have known the word for what makes one. I did not think to ask.

the_unpicked.codex_line: Her own work, pulled from the walls and worn wrong.
the_unpicked.name: The Unpicked
the_unpicked.flavor: A shape wearing the room's unravelled threads. Prologue only: it is not meant to be beaten. Yet.
the_unpicked.codex: The shape in her parlor. Made of her own work, pulled out of the walls and put ON, and it did not stop when it saw me — it decided I was not an interruption and went back to what it was doing. That is the part I keep.

the_vole.codex_line: Not a monster. Barely even a meal.
the_vole.name: The Vole
the_vole.flavor: It holds very still. It believes this is working.
the_vole.codex: Microtus, the common field vole. Eats grass, fears everything, and has exactly one plan: be somewhere else, immediately, in a straight line. Not a monster. Not an enemy. A gift, if you are quick, and an apology if you are not.

tallow_hound.codex_line: A yard dog gone glossy on render-scraps.
tallow_hound.name: The Tallow Hound
tallow_hound.flavor: The render-yards' dog. Nobody owns him. Everybody feeds him.
tallow_hound.codex: A yard dog gone glossy on render-scraps, patrolling the wax-yards on the theory that whoever feeds you is whoever you work for. No chain on this one. The Chandlers found it cheaper to be generous.

candle_golem.codex_line: Poured wax on the night shift, wick lit.
candle_golem.name: A Candle-Golem
candle_golem.flavor: Votive wax, walking. It is very sorry about the scalding.
candle_golem.codex: The Chandlers' night staff: poured men of votive wax with a lit wick where the thinking would go. Smashing one splashes. Smothering the wick stops it politely. It does not hate you; it is on shift.

the_drowned.codex_line: Nearer every time you look. Never chasing.
the_drowned.name: One of the Drowned
the_drowned.flavor: Dry-footed on a wet street. Never fast. Always arriving.
the_drowned.codex: The Mere's patient people. They do not chase; they are simply nearer each time you look, the way the tide is. What they want is not you. It is for you to stop holding the door.

the_tallowman.codex_line: A century of votives in one patient, apologetic shape.
the_tallowman.name: The Tallowman
the_tallowman.flavor: Wick's bodyguard: a gentle-voiced tower of votive wax. It would rather you left.
the_tallowman.codex: A hundred years of guild votives poured into one patient shape. It speaks softly, apologizes sincerely, and reforms whatever you cut off. It has never once raised its voice. It has never once needed to.

the_empty_coat.name: The Empty Coat
the_empty_coat.flavor: Out wearing someone's evening. It fits nobody. It tries everyone.
the_empty_coat.codex: A rag-wraith that has found a whole coat rather than scraps, and is wearing somebody's evening around. Fuller than its cousins, and better dressed than most of the people it passes.
